scenes.headline: Your island
scenes.narration: Welcome to Futbol Island! This is your very own football island. Explore it, play, and learn the game one path at a time.

scenes.headline: Walk & run
scenes.narration: On a phone, drag the joystick in the corner to walk. On a computer, use W A S D or the arrow keys, and hold Shift to run.
scenes.say: On a phone, drag the joystick in the corner to walk. On a computer, use W, A, S, D, or the arrow keys, and hold Shift to run.

scenes.headline: Rides
scenes.narration: Tap the ride button, or press R, to switch from walking to a scooter, bike, moped or jetpack. The two action buttons, or Space and J, do tricks.

scenes.headline: Fly & glide
scenes.narration: With the jetpack you fly over the rooftops. Blast up high and a parachute opens, so you can glide down and pick where to land.

scenes.headline: The map
scenes.narration: Not sure where to go? Tap the map in the corner, or press M, to see the whole island and travel there fast.

scenes.headline: Island jobs
scenes.narration: Find a job sign and help out, like raking leaves or being a ball kid. Finish the job to earn coins. Your coins show at the top of the screen.

scenes.headline: Go fishing
scenes.narration: At a fishing spot, tap Cast. Wait for the float to plunge, tap Hook, then reel your fish in. Sell fish and fruit to Rosa at her market stand.

scenes.headline: Spend coins
scenes.narration: Spend coins at the vending machines on cards, balls, rides and pop-up books. Everything goes in your Backpack. Tap your character to open it.

scenes.headline: The arcade
scenes.narration: In the arcade, try Island Strikers, Futbol Pinball, Pass Puzzles and more. Most games cost three coins a play, and Scores shows the leaderboards.

scenes.headline: Explore
scenes.narration: Over a hundred balls are hidden around the islands, and each one teaches a football tip. On Summit Isle, kick the fruit trees, solve the riddle board and peek into the huts and caves.

scenes.headline: The museum
scenes.narration: Walk into the History Museum to find out how football got its first rules, its World Cups, and its kits and boots.

scenes.headline: Meet people
scenes.narration: Island characters share football stories and tips. Tap them, or press E, to talk. At the KIT SHOP, design your own jersey, boots and ball.
scenes.say: Island characters share football stories and tips. Tap them, or press E, to talk. At the Kit Shop, design your own jersey, boots and ball.

scenes.headline: Paths
scenes.narration: In Paths, watch each play and try its quiz. Finishing them unlocks the next stop. Learn futsal, 7v7, 9v9 and 11v11. Stories are optional.
scenes.say: In Paths, watch each play and try its quiz. Finishing them unlocks the next stop. Learn futsal, seven v seven, nine v nine, and eleven v eleven. Stories are optional.

scenes.headline: Need help?
scenes.narration: Open Settings for keyboard shortcuts, the time of day, and a save code that keeps your island safe. Now go have fun exploring!
